newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico cenbank adheres to rigid money supply rule.
newsitem.headline: Mexico cenbank adheres to rigid money supply rule.

text.p: Mexico's central bank governor on Wednesday insisted the bank would not stray from its commitment not to permit the amount of money it provides to the system to stray over the level of demand.
"This promise not to allow an increase in the monetary base (over demand) is a discipline at the central bank -- we are very inflexible about this," Banco de Mexico governor Miguel Mancera said.
"We are adhering to this formula that never allows an expansion in the system," he added.
He was speaking to reporters at a news conference called after a flurry of articles accusing the bank of allowing Mexico's monetary base to grow in the run-up to July Congressional elections.
